description: This file defines memory allocation and management interfaces, including DataPtr class, Allocator interface, and related utilities for device memory management in PyTorch.

classes.name: DataPtr
classes.description: A unique pointer to memory with an attached deleter and device info, supporting safe memory management across devices.

classes.name: Allocator
classes.description: Abstract interface for memory allocators, supporting allocation, cloning, copying, and deallocation of device memory.

classes.name: InefficientStdFunctionContext
classes.description: A context for managing external data with custom deleters, using dynamic allocation for std::function.

classes.name: MemoryReportingInfoBase
classes.description: Interface for reporting thread-local memory usage and profiling information per device.

classes.name: GatheredContext
classes.description: Base class for holding traceback or context information in allocators.

classes.name: Stat
classes.description: Structure for tracking memory allocation statistics, including current, peak, total allocated, and freed memory.

classes.name: DurationStat
classes.description: Structure for tracking timing information such as total, max, min durations, and count.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of memory data from an existing allocation.

methods.name: is_simple_data_ptr
methods.description: Checks if a DataPtr has a simple, unwrapped context.

methods.name: raw_deleter
methods.description: Returns the deleter function used for raw allocations, if supported.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates a block of device memory.

methods.name: copy_data
methods.description: Copies memory data between two allocations.

methods.name: reportMemoryUsage
methods.description: Reports memory usage statistics for a specific pointer and device.

methods.name: makeDataPtr
methods.description: Creates a DataPtr with a custom deleter and device info.
